test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold.

We'd better watch our step and not give him any excuse to __**harass** __us further.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"harass"** means to trouble, torment, or bully someone persistently. (परेशान करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He was** harassed** by bullies at school every day.
 
 
 
• **"Intimidate"** refers to making someone feel frightened or overawed, especially in order to make them do what one wants. (डराना)
 
 
• **Example: **The gang tried to **intimidate** the shop owner into paying them protection money.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'harass'** is **'intimidate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Betray** (धोखा देना): To expose someone to danger by treacherously giving information to an enemy.

 
 
• **Example:** He was accused of betraying his country during the war.
 
 
 
• **Relish** (आनंद लेना): To enjoy greatly.
 
 
• **Example: **She relished the opportunity to travel and see new places.
 
 
 
• **Soothe** (शांत करना): To gently calm someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** She tried to soothe the crying baby with a lullaby.
